reviewer.role: Independent diagnostic source/resource reviewer; no implementation or dispatch

scope: One read-only node/indexer diagnostic under the exact seven reviewed files. One public preflight plus at most one conditional SDK query. Zero wallet/private reads, recovery writes, proofs, submissions, DUST and gross debit; no automatic recovery successor or financial acceptance.
rationale: The failed recovery attempt retained only CalledProcessError and discarded the public cause. This bounded diagnostic changes the observation mechanism: it retains phase, class, recognized predicate and bounded public message, with a single supplementary exact SDK query when needed. It reuses the approved public preflight without modifying recovery source or opening private inputs. The two-service/Node CPU-memory-time envelope is finite and independently stopped.

resolvedDuringReview.resolution: Final reviewed version preserves a bounded ASCII publicMessage for every caught string/message, retaining class and allowlisted code as supplemental classification. Root supplied this correction before final hash commitment; no edits were made by this reviewer.

checks.detail: Verified all seven final file hashes and unchanged approved source-candidate03 with all 28 file digests. Python runner parsed with ast.parse without execution/import. node --check diagnose-preflight.mjs passed without diagnostic execution.

The reviewed public preflight reads public deployment/build/native/state evidence only; no launchLocalFinancialCase, integration driver, constructor reconstruction, private provider, wallet or proof API is called.

checks.name: error-evidence
checks.detail: Final classify retains errorClass/localCode/publicMessage instead of discarding unclassified text. Message is ASCII-clipped to 2048 characters; filesystem codes ENOENT/EACCES/ELOOP/EISDIR receive explicit labels. Main failurePhase survives the optional SDK query. Only message/string and class/code are projected; stack, cause objects and arbitrary properties are not serialized.

checks.name: pure-classifier-adversarial-check
checks.detail: Executed only the extracted pure clip/classes/classify block in a VM, without diagnostic imports or network. Six local codes including INVALID_PAID_FEES, INVALID_ESTIMATED_FEES and RECOVERY_STATE_MISMATCH remain exact; lowercase build receipt hash mismatch retains its message; ENOENT is classified; long messages clip to 2048; thrown string remains; stack/arbitrary object canaries are excluded.

checks.name: single-SDK-query
checks.detail: Only actual-preflight IndexerQueryError or unclassified message with remaining time reaches oneSdkQuery once. sdk-query.json exactly equals TX_ID_QUERY and variables emitted by the previously independently reproduced installed SDK fixture. Same local indexer, POST/read-only GraphQL, redirects forbidden, <=5s/shared deadline, <=256KiB retained prefix, digest/HTTP/count/error projection; no arbitrary raw response or transaction payload emitted.

checks.name: exclusive-bounded-output
checks.detail: Writes one exclusive no-follow 0600 diagnostic-result, fsyncs file/directory, then exits. Output is hard rejected above 64KiB; messages/errors are truncated. SDK stdout/stderr go to null. Native kill, retention error or oversized projected output can still leave no result and must remain missing evidence, never diagnostic success.

checks.name: exact-admission-and-actual-votes
checks.detail: Before attempt/timer requires ADMITTED, all seven files, exact proposal/source commitment, all current source hashes, and two distinct GPT6/Grok source reviews plus two resource votes with accepted verdicts, subject hashes and admission-bound actualReview paths. Faithful construction from actual completed reviews remains an admission responsibility; this draft does not fabricate those records.

checks.name: independent-containment
checks.detail: Independent +180s timer with <=1s accuracy kills whole diagnostic cgroup under5s, stops only node/indexer under20s and runs Docker kill for them under5s stop-post. Reads actual timer monotonic expiry before starting containers. +31s planned cleanup fits total211s. Missing diagnostic result does not disable shutdown.

checks.name: activation-and-Node-envelope
checks.detail: Activation command must complete by arming+90s and active-entry timestamp must be within that window. Node gets 4GiB, zero swap, 200% CPU, RuntimeMaxSec90, stop timeout1, whole-cgroup/SIGKILL, plus internal89s deadline. Readiness, public preflight and optionalquery share that89s budget. Setup exceptions attempt bounded same-cgroup and same-two-container cleanup; no retries.

checks.detail: Requires all three original containers exited; validates node/indexer exact images and each5GiB memory/10GiB memory+swap/fourCPU/restartno. Requires proof server exact image and stopped. Starts only node/indexer; proof server is absent from all start/stop/kill lists. No recreate/reset or writable-layer replacement.

checks.name: private-identity-and-charges
checks.detail: Private paths remain inert validated strings in the public plan. Diagnostic writes only public result/attempt/control observations, with no new private base/password/store/roles/snapshot operations. Prior three submissions and900000000000003SPECK plus consumed recovery01 and other historical service/review charges stay retained; zero new submissions/proofs/financial debit are permitted.

conditions: Require agreeing completed Grok source/resource vote on these exact seven files, then a separately faithful exact admission with both actual vote references and retained current source approvals. This one vote is not a dispatch.

Execute these exact bytes once under non-optimized Python, preserving one-use attempt/result absence checks. No preflight retry, extra query, service extension, wallet/private operation, source edit, funding, registration, redeployment or automatic successor.

Before starting services, all exact admission/source/container/headroom checks must actually pass. Keep proof server stopped, preserve node/indexer writable layers and all original identity/store/snapshot/journal files.

Do not exceed 180s services,90s Node diagnostic,211s planned total including cleanup, existing per-container and Node memory/CPU caps,64KiB diagnostic output or one conditional query with256KiB read ceiling.

Observe terminal cgroup emptiness and both containers stopped independently after the timer or setup cleanup. Active timer, process exit, attempted Docker kill or missing output is not successful containment evidence.

Interpret bounded publicMessage, localCode, failurePhase and optional-query observations together. Truncated/missing messages, deadline or missing result remain explicit limits; do not infer an actual schema/state cause from the earlier synthetic fixture.

Any PUBLIC_STATE_VERIFIED result is only the scoped public observation supplied by the unchanged helper; it does not authorize private restore, loan calls, financial/Preview/full-SP05/PCD acceptance or reuse of the consumed recovery allocation.
Retain the failed recovery evidence and all historical charges. This diagnostic consumes one additional service/review attempt even if it fails before producing useful output.
limitations: No diagnostic/operational process was dispatched, no real service was started or queried and no private files were accessed during this review. Only static inspection, syntax checks, pure classification tests and offline public-plan validation ran.
Actual preflight cause, live server behavior, current canonical state and terminal runtime containment remain unestablished.
Underlying SDK operations are not claimed intrinsically cancellable; process/cgroup/container containment is required.

Bounded error projection is not arbitrary error-object or raw-response retention. Missing/non-string/deep cause-only errors or a failed/oversized retention can still limit diagnosis; these outcomes must be reported honestly.
The output ceiling does not establish an aggregate hard disk quota for existing container writable layers; CPU/memory/time bounds and preflight free-disk check remain the resource controls.
Admission record construction must preserve actual reviewer identity and exact-file conditions; normalized records alone are not independent votes.
